text:
ola: quick thread  onboarding team keeps hitting mismatched request ids and leaked PII in traces. node/python/go SDKs all behave differently. can we align on keys + redaction?

mike: yes — two separate problems: canonical request id propagation and applying redaction consistently across logs, spans, and OTLP exports.

sana: for request id I'd like `request_id` (snake_case) as canonical. wire it into: (1) response header `x-request-id` for backwards compat, (2) OTEL baggage entry `request_id`, (3) span attribute `request_id`, and (4) structured log context `request_id`.

ola: agreed. small fastapi example I used: 
```py
async def reqid_middleware(req, call_next):
    rid = req.headers.get('x-request-id') or str(uuid.uuid4())
    baggage.set_baggage('request_id', rid)
    structlog.threadlocal.bind_threadlocal(request_id=rid)
    resp = await call_next(req)
    resp.headers['x-request-id'] = rid
    return resp
```

mike: node express version: 
```js
app.use((req, res, next) => {
  const rid = req.headers['x-request-id'] || uuid.v4();
  req.request_id = rid;
  res.setHeader('x-request-id', rid);
  const span = tracer.getActiveSpan && tracer.getActiveSpan();
  if (span) span.setAttribute('request_id', rid);
  propagation.setBaggage(createBaggageEntry('request_id', rid));
  next();
});
```

sana: good. second part: redaction. current SDKs only run redaction when formatting logs. OTLP exporters serialize span attributes untouched. suggestion: SDKs should offer two hooks: `telemetry.pre_process_span(span)` called inline when attributes/events are set, and `telemetry.pre_export_batch(batch)` called just before exporter serializes payload. Default implementation applies configured redaction rules to attributes/events/resource attributes.

ivy: config snippet example I propose: 
```yaml
telemetry:
  redaction_rules:
    - id: redact_email
      type: regex
      pattern: "(?i)[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}"
      replace_with: "[REDACTED_EMAIL]"
    - id: block_keys
      type: key_blocklist
      keys: ["password","ssn","api_key","credit_card"]
  exporter:
    min_export_level: "info"
    capture_bodies: false
```

ola: important: set `min_export_level` default to INFO and `capture_bodies:false` so DEBUG doesn't accidentally export request bodies. when debugging, integrators can explicitly enable `capture_bodies` with a warning.

mike: implementation notes: pre_process_span should be low-overhead and best-effort, called whenever a span attribute is set. pre_export_batch can be heavier and should sanitize the whole payload (resource, span attrs, events). also provide a `telemetry.pre_export_hook` API so customers can plug custom sanitizers.

sana: tests we need: unit tests asserting redaction works for attributes and logs, integration test that runs sample-apps (node + python) and scans OTLP JSON for any PII regex matches, and an e2e sample that shows identical `request_id` in response header, logs, and exported spans. CI job should fail on any regex matches.

telemetry-bot: CI telemetry-integration #298 failed: node_redaction.integration found `test@example.com` in span attribute `http.request.body`.

ivy: i'll add a linter step `telemetry-lint` that scans exporter payloads for configured sensitive regexes and fails CI. quick implementation: export OTLP as JSON in a temp file and run regex checks in CI.

mike: also, add a small SDK default redactor that supports `regex` and `key_blocklist` rule types + `replace_with` tokens. make sure language SDKs share the same canonical rule set in sample-apps config to avoid drift.

ola: can someone draft a short RFC covering: canonical key `request_id`, SDK API shape (`redaction_rules`, `pre_process_span`, `pre_export_batch`/`pre_export_hook`), exporter defaults (`min_export_level`, `capture_bodies`), and required tests (unit, integration, telemetry-lint)? i'll review.

sana: i'll do node changes + pre_export_batch hook and a test scanning OTLP JSON.

ivy: i'll update sample-apps with an end-to-end demo and docs showing how to enable capture_bodies safely.

mike: i'll update python SDK: structlog binding to `request_id`, baggage set, and add pre_export_batch hook. also add unit test that ensures an email in a prompt is not present in the exported span JSON.

ola: thanks all. timeline: PRs for node/python/sample-apps + RFC in 48h. keep this thread for followups. :rocket:
